sam: SQL snippets ready, will share. Also set automation: registered -> CRM tag bench-may25.

olivia: I'll take copy. Short, metric-led for High. Deliver first drafts Mon 9am PT.

alex: Subjects (rapid): High: "Live benchmark results  save your seat" / "How teams cut inference cost"; Medium: "Top takeaways from our benchmark"; Low: "Quick guide: reduce inference cost"

pat: Checklist: segments, templates, Litmus QA, tracking CTAs, seed send.
